build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run bundle:runtime

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; worker-src blob:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A quiet place to play the games you already own
bundle.longDescription: Play is a local-first launcher that sorts, repairs, and shelves your game files, boots them through RetroArch, and resumes where you left off.
